2024_general.fact: Ruled LATER under DECISIONS 67 (rule 43), same pattern as Live Oak 2026 primary (county totals printed on election night, uploaded later, no precinct report). The 2024 County and Entity Elections page lists for 'November 5, 2024 - JOINT AND GENERAL ELECTION' only one results file, 'Unofficial Final - Includes Limited Ballots': 'Cumulative Results Report WALLER COUNTY, TEXAS Unofficial Results ... GENERAL ELECTION ... Ballots Cast 27671 ... Precincts Reporting 29 of 29 = 100.00% Run Time 10:07PM ... Run Date 11/05/2024', 9 pages of county totals by Absentee, Early and Election Day Voting (no per-precinct pages). Printed run time 10:07 PM on election night; the online copy has PDF CreationDate 2024-11-09 21:59:07 UTC and Last-Modified Sun, 10 Nov 2024 16:31:23 GMT (after election night). No unofficial or official precinct report is listed for this election. Caveat: the CreationDate (also a printed time under the checklist) is after election night, so the posted copy was rendered later even though its printed Run Time is 10:07 PM election night; and Waller has delisted election-night files before (a 2024 March primary file 'Joint Primary Early Voting Cumulative Results-3-5-2024 08-20-24 PM.pdf' is on the server but not on the page), so an election-night posting later removed cannot be ruled out (DECISIONS 67 caveat).
